title: Not user friendly
text:
Not user friendly. Looks nice enough, but there were a few issues:

1. The instructions did not give a close view for the small pieces. I felt like I was guessing.

2. Some of the holes weren't drilled in my shelf, so it's a little less stable. I didn't feel like sending it back so I'm just dealing with it.

3. The last step is to screw the two pieces together. They don't hold them together well at all. They are splitting off and I'm afraid it's going to fall.

4. The plugs don't fit.
